metadata.description: Wire format for `GET /v1/purls/{purl}`: usable versions describing the PURL and refused versions that would also have matched. Read both by `crates/vibe-registry/src/index_client/wire.rs` (`PurlLookupResults`, `PurlLookupHit`, `BindingSite`) and raw `curl | jq` consumers. Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/purls.rs` (`Response`, `Hit`, `lookup`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/purls_response/`.
The requested package URL as supplied by the caller; consumed by the vibe-registry client view.
How many usable hit rows the response carries; consumed by the client view. The writer and view use usize; uint32 is JTD's widest exact unsigned integer.
Every usable version describing the PURL, in lookup order. Required even when empty and consumed by the client view.
Refused versions that would have matched the PURL, absent when none exist.
One usable package version describing the requested PURL. Every client-view field is present; `group` is a server addition tolerated by that view.
The version's installable kind, consumed by the client view.
The package's bare name, consumed by the client view.
The semantic version describing the PURL, consumed by the client view.
Whether the package or one subskill declared the binding; consumed by the client view.
Where the PURL binding originated: the version's package-level `describes` field or a subskill's `describes` field. Closed because both values name concrete places in the writer model.
One package version this build refuses and the recovery recipe, mirroring `crates/vibe-index/src/index/quarantine.rs::Unavailable`.
The refused version's bare package name.
Reader capabilities unknown to this build, in record order.
The generated explanation and fix surface for the refusal.
